output.reason: A 70-year-old with severe cramping abdominal pain since last night, visible distension, repeated vomiting and no bowel movement for 3 days describes a classic bowel-obstruction pattern requiring immediate emergency imaging, IV access and surgical assessment.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Severe cramping belly pain with bloating, repeated vomiting and no bowel movement for three days can mean a blocked bowel, which needs urgent scans and hospital treatment. Don't eat or drink anything on the way. If you faint, vomit blood, or become too unwell or lightheaded to travel safely, call 911 instead of driving yourself.
differential: Mechanical bowel obstruction (small or large bowel)
